description: Privacy-safe wrapper observation path: exact native passthrough, bounded outbox, bounded fail-open upload, and status/explain surfaces. Controlled overhead remains explicitly pending without a CONTROLLED_PERFORMANCE runner.

implementation.seam: new buildoptw entrypoint plus wcncpobserve helpers; launcher task selection untouched
implementation.recorderStart: only when WCNCP_REPOSITORY_SCOPE and WCNCP_OUTBOX_DIR are configured; no pre-child network

deterministicGates: exact exit/stdout/stderr/stdin/cwd/argv passthrough with real binaries
non-zero exit and POSIX signal preserved and never replaced by observation errors
wrapper records match the canonical observation schema consumed by typed storage
BUILDOPT_BYPASS=1 skips recording without changing native behavior
secret-looking inputs become REDACTED_SECRET and never reach the outbox
absolute paths outside the repo become OMITTED
atomic outbox enqueue with oldest-first bounded retry and 30-day age eviction
only an exact backend acknowledgement deletes uploaded observations
outage/slow/corrupt backends stay queued and preserve the native result
status distinguishes UNAVAILABLE, QUEUED, OBSERVING, and proposal states using a verified remote projection
Windows build compiles; Windows-shaped paths classify statically
pendingOnlyOnControlledRunner: 0.5 percent mean wall-time overhead on workflows of at least 10 seconds
